title: World Health Organization 2020 guidelines on physical activity and sedentary behaviour
doc_summary:
Here are 8 concise bullet points summarizing the recommendations and behaviour-change measures:
* Adults should undertake 150-300 min of moderate-intensity or 75-150 min of vigorous-intensity physical activity per week
* Children and adolescents should aim for 60 min/day of moderate-to-vigorous intensity aerobic physical activity
* Regular muscle-strengthening activity is recommended for all age groups
* Reducing sedentary behaviours is recommended across all age groups and abilities
* Pregnant and postpartum women should follow specific physical activity recommendations
* People living with chronic conditions or disability should also follow specific physical activity recommendations
* Countries should establish national guidelines and set physical activity targets to promote healthy levels of physical activity
* National and subnational policies and programmes should be developed to enable people of all ages and abilities to be physically active and improve health
